content.json:
# Tag Governance
Resource Group และ VM ที่ยังไม่ผ่าน policy `rg-tag-governance-audit` · ดึงสดจาก Azure Policy ทุกครั้งที่เปิด · ผลอัปเดตช้าราว 1 วันหลังแก้ tag

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == "microsoft.policyinsights/policystates"
| where tolower(tostring(properties.policyAssignmentId)) endswith "/providers/microsoft.authorization/policyassignments/rg-tag-governance-audit"
| where tostring(properties.complianceState) == "NonCompliant"
| where tostring(properties.resourceType) =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups"
| extend resource_id = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)), policy = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionReferenceId)
| summarize failed_policies = make_set(policy) by resource_id
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups" | project resource_id = tolower(id), azure_id = id, resource_name = name, rg_name = name, tags) on resource_id
| extend t = todynamic(tostring(tags))
| extend owner_value = tostring(t.owner)
| mv-expand policy = failed_policies
| extend tag = replace_string(tolower(tostring(policy)), "require-tag-", "")
| extend tag_value = tostring(t[tag])
| extend problem = case(tag == "owner" and owner_value =~ "nan", "owner = nan", tag == "owner" and isempty(tag_value), "ไม่มี owner", tag == "owner", "owner รูปแบบผิด", isempty(tag_value), strcat("ไม่มี ", tag), strcat(tag, " ค่าไม่ถูก: ", tag_value))
| extend rank = case(tag == "owner", 0, isempty(tag_value), 1, 2)
| order by resource_id asc, rank asc, tag asc
| summarize problems = make_list(problem), n_missing = countif(tag != "owner" and isempty(tag_value)), failed_policies = make_set(policy) by resource_id, azure_id, resource_name, rg_name, owner_value, tags_s = tostring(tags)
| extend cause = case(isempty(tags_s) or tags_s == "{}", "ไม่มี tag เลย", owner_value =~ "nan", "owner = nan", isempty(owner_value), "ไม่มี owner tag", tostring(failed_policies) contains "owner", "owner รูปแบบผิด", "tag อื่นไม่ครบ")
| extend detail = iff(cause == "ไม่มี tag เลย", "ไม่มี tag เลย", array_strcat(problems, ", "))
| extend who = case(cause in ("ไม่มี tag เลย", "owner = nan", "ไม่มี owner tag"), "หา owner ก่อน", n_missing > 0, "ถาม owner", "Cloud team แก้ได้")
| project resource_id, azure_id, resource_kind = "Resource Group", resource_name, rg_name, cause, detail, owner_value, who
| union (
policyresources
| where type == "microsoft.policyinsights/policystates"
| where tolower(tostring(properties.policyAssignmentId)) endswith "/providers/microsoft.authorization/policyassignments/rg-tag-governance-audit"
| where tostring(properties.complianceState) == "NonCompliant"
| where tostring(properties.resourceType) =~ "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines"
| extend resource_id = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)), policy = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionReferenceId)
| summarize failed_policies = make_set(policy) by resource_id
| join kind=leftouter (resources | where type =~ "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines" | project resource_id = tolower(id), azure_id = id, resource_name = name, rg_name = tostring(split(id, "/")[4]), tags) on resource_id
| extend t = todynamic(tostring(tags))
| extend owner_value = tostring(t.owner)
| mv-expand policy = failed_policies
| extend tag = replace_string(tolower(tostring(policy)), "require-tag-", "")
| extend tag_value = tostring(t[tag])
| extend problem = case(tag == "owner" and owner_value =~ "nan", "owner = nan", tag == "owner" and isempty(tag_value), "ไม่มี owner", tag == "owner", "owner รูปแบบผิด", isempty(tag_value), strcat("ไม่มี ", tag), strcat(tag, " ค่าไม่ถูก: ", tag_value))
| extend rank = case(tag == "owner", 0, isempty(tag_value), 1, 2)
| order by resource_id asc, rank asc, tag asc
| summarize problems = make_list(problem), n_missing = countif(tag != "owner" and isempty(tag_value)), failed_policies = make_set(policy) by resource_id, azure_id, resource_name, rg_name, owner_value, tags_s = tostring(tags)
| extend cause = case(isempty(tags_s) or tags_s == "{}", "ไม่มี tag เลย", owner_value =~ "nan", "owner = nan", isempty(owner_value), "ไม่มี owner tag", tostring(failed_policies) contains "owner", "owner รูปแบบผิด", "tag อื่นไม่ครบ")
| extend detail = iff(cause == "ไม่มี tag เลย", "ไม่มี tag เลย", array_strcat(problems, ", "))
| extend who = case(cause in ("ไม่มี tag เลย", "owner = nan", "ไม่มี owner tag"), "หา owner ก่อน", n_missing > 0, "ถาม owner", "Cloud team แก้ได้")
| project resource_id, azure_id, resource_kind = "Virtual Machine", resource_name, rg_name, cause, detail, owner_value, who
)
| summarize n0 = count(), rg0 = countif(resource_kind == "Resource Group"), vm0 = countif(resource_kind == "Virtual Machine"), n1 = countif(who == "Cloud team แก้ได้"), rg1 = countif(who == "Cloud team แก้ได้" and resource_kind == "Resource Group"), vm1 = countif(who == "Cloud team แก้ได้" and resource_kind == "Virtual Machine"), n2 = countif(who == "ถาม owner"), rg2 = countif(who == "ถาม owner" and resource_kind == "Resource Group"), vm2 = countif(who == "ถาม owner" and resource_kind == "Virtual Machine"), n3 = countif(who == "หา owner ก่อน"), rg3 = countif(who == "หา owner ก่อน" and resource_kind == "Resource Group"), vm3 = countif(who == "หา owner ก่อน" and resource_kind == "Virtual Machine")
| extend p = pack_array(pack("ord", 0, "k", "ไม่ผ่านทั้งหมด", "n", n0, "sub", strcat("RG ", rg0, "  ·  VM ", vm0)), pack("ord", 1, "k", "Cloud team แก้ได้", "n", n1, "sub", strcat("RG ", rg1, "  ·  VM ", vm1)), pack("ord", 2, "k", "ถาม owner", "n", n2, "sub", strcat("RG ", rg2, "  ·  VM ", vm2)), pack("ord", 3, "k", "หา owner ก่อน", "n", n3, "sub", strcat("RG ", rg3, "  ·  VM ", vm3)))
| mv-expand p
| project ord = toint(p.ord), title = tostring(p.k), n = toint(p.n), sub = tostring(p.sub)
| order by ord asc

content.json:
**Cloud team แก้ได้** — tag มีค่าแล้วแต่รูปแบบหรือค่าไม่ถูก แก้ได้เลย  
**ถาม owner** — มี owner แต่ขาด tag อื่น ติดต่อ owner เพื่อขอข้อมูล  
**หา owner ก่อน** — ไม่มี owner ที่ติดต่อได้ ต้องหาเจ้าของ resource ก่อน
